seo.title: Krabi Airport to Ao Nang Minivan Taxi | VIP Taxi Lanta
seo.metaDescription: Private minivan taxi between Krabi Airport (KBV) and Ao Nang, both directions, straight to your hotel. Cash to the driver, no prepayment. Price on WhatsApp.

routes.h1: Krabi Airport to Ao Nang, private minivan taxi
routes.lead: From the arrivals at Krabi Airport (KBV) to your hotel in Ao Nang, or the other way, in a private minivan.
body: Send your flight number and landing time, your hotel in Ao Nang and the number of people. The team confirms the price on WhatsApp and the driver waits for you at the airport.

faq.q: Can you drop us at a pier in Ao Nang for Railay?
faq.a: Yes. Tell us which pier and at what time in the request form.

points: Hotels on all the beaches of Khao Lak

seo.title: Phuket Airport to Khao Lak Minivan Taxi | VIP Taxi Lanta
seo.metaDescription: Private minivan taxi between Phuket Airport (HKT) and Khao Lak, both directions, straight to your hotel. Cash to the driver. Price on WhatsApp.

routes.h1: Phuket Airport to Khao Lak, private transfer
routes.lead: From Phuket Airport (HKT) to your hotel in Khao Lak, or back to the airport for your flight, in a private minivan.
body: Give us your flight time, your hotel in Khao Lak and the number of people. The team confirms the price on WhatsApp and the driver waits for you at the airport.

faq.q: Do you serve all the beaches of Khao Lak?
faq.a: Yes. Give us the name of your hotel and the driver takes you to the door.

seo.title: Krabi to Khao Sok Minivan Taxi | VIP Taxi Lanta
seo.metaDescription: Private minivan taxi between Krabi, Ao Nang or Krabi Airport and Khao Sok or Cheow Lan Pier, both directions. Cash to the driver. Price on WhatsApp.

routes.h1: Krabi to Khao Sok, private transfer
routes.lead: From Krabi Town, Ao Nang or Krabi Airport to Khao Sok village or Cheow Lan Pier, and back, in a private minivan.
body: Tell us where we pick you up in Krabi and whether you are going to the village or to Cheow Lan Pier, with your boat time if you have one. The team confirms the price on WhatsApp.

faq.q: Do you drive to Cheow Lan Pier?
faq.a: Yes. Enter Cheow Lan Pier as your destination with the time of your boat.

seo.title: Phuket to Khao Sok Minivan Taxi | VIP Taxi Lanta
seo.metaDescription: Private minivan taxi between Phuket or Phuket Airport and Khao Sok or Cheow Lan Pier, both directions, door to door. Cash to the driver. Price on WhatsApp.

routes.h1: Phuket to Khao Sok, private transfer
routes.lead: From your hotel in Phuket or from Phuket Airport to Khao Sok village or Cheow Lan Pier, and back, in a private minivan.
body: Tell us where we pick you up in Phuket and whether you are going to the village or to Cheow Lan Pier. The team confirms the price on WhatsApp.

faq.q: Can you pick us up at Phuket Airport for Khao Sok?
faq.a: Yes. Send your flight time and the driver waits for you at the airport.

seo.title: Surat Thani to Khao Sok Minivan Taxi | VIP Taxi Lanta
seo.metaDescription: Private minivan taxi between Surat Thani (airport, bus terminal or Donsak Pier) and Khao Sok or Cheow Lan Pier, both directions. Price on WhatsApp.

routes.h1: Surat Thani to Khao Sok, private transfer
routes.lead: From Surat Thani Airport, the bus terminal or Donsak Pier to Khao Sok village or Cheow Lan Pier, and back, in a private vehicle.
body: Tell us where we pick you up in Surat Thani and at what time. The team confirms the price on WhatsApp.

faq.q: Do you pick up at Donsak Pier for Khao Sok?
faq.a: Yes. Give us your ferry arrival time and the driver waits at the pier.

seo.title: Phuket Airport to Ao Nang Minivan Taxi | VIP Taxi Lanta
seo.metaDescription: Private minivan taxi between Phuket Airport (HKT) and Ao Nang or Krabi, both directions, straight to your hotel. Cash to the driver. Price on WhatsApp.

routes.lead: From Krabi Airport (KBV) to your hotel in Khao Lak, or back to the airport, in a private minivan.

faq.q: Is the Khao Lak transfer private?
